main_question: What is the difference between a lip flip and lip filler, and what should the working reader understand before discussing either option with Estar?
execution_order: Client-first prerequisite satisfied by the permitted practice-page review recorded here. Revisit allowed pages for specific remaining questions without inspecting Estar blogs.
Read supplied R1 only in the later Research and Resolve stage; use it to identify questions and references, not as copy or sole medical authority.
Gather authoritative treatment-specific evidence for I1-I9 and resolve the observed website contradictions; keep current practice facts separate from medical evidence.
Carry out the planned leading organic Google review I16 and verify competing medical claims against authoritative evidence.
Resolve practice/customer questions I10-I15 with permitted sources and Alex where only the customer can confirm.
Record supported answers and assess each unresolved dependency before any outline. Do not start those steps during this trial.

investigations.question_or_claim: How do a lip flip and lip filler differ in mechanism, anatomical target and effect on lip volume?
investigations.why_it_matters: Central answer to the assigned question; avoid treating every injectable as a volume-producing filler.
investigations.adequate_resolution_evidence: Find treatment-specific clinical evidence for perioral botulinum toxin and lip augmentation, cross-check product labeling, and distinguish observed appearance from added volume. Record evidence limitations and correct the Xeomin-category issue without borrowing competitor wording.
investigations.resolution_owner: Research; Alex if practice-only facts remain unavailable

investigations.question_or_claim: Which lip goals and anatomical concerns could each treatment address, and where might one, both or neither be suitable?
investigations.why_it_matters: Gives the working reader decision context without prescribing a treatment or promising naturalness.
investigations.adequate_resolution_evidence: Use clinical sources addressing lip visibility, volume, asymmetry and smiling-related concerns. Distinguish a lip flip from separately targeted gummy-smile treatment; establish limits and need for individual assessment. Do not derive suitability from title or marketing alone.
investigations.resolution_owner: Research; Alex if practice-only facts remain unavailable

investigations.question_or_claim: What onset, settling period and duration can responsibly be described for each treatment?
investigations.why_it_matters: Reader expectations, maintenance and the contradictory practice onset descriptions need resolution.
investigations.adequate_resolution_evidence: Use lip-specific evidence with product, dose/technique, follow-up and patient variation stated. Separate visible early change from final settled result. Reconcile P13/P14; generic forehead Botox or all-face filler duration cannot establish a lip-specific range.
investigations.resolution_owner: Research; Alex if practice-only facts remain unavailable

investigations.question_or_claim: What common adverse effects, functional effects and serious complications need to be explained?
investigations.why_it_matters: Supports informed comparison and prevents unsupported low-risk or risk-free framing.
investigations.adequate_resolution_evidence: Find current approved-label warnings and clinical evidence for each procedure. Investigate effects on oral function, injection-related reactions and filler vascular complications; establish what symptoms warrant prompt assessment from authoritative guidance. Avoid numerical risk comparisons without comparable evidence.
investigations.resolution_owner: Research; Alex if practice-only facts remain unavailable

investigations.question_or_claim: How do candidacy, age, medical history, pregnancy/breastfeeding, allergies and active oral infection affect the discussion?
investigations.why_it_matters: Website eligibility language must not become a universal medical rule.
investigations.adequate_resolution_evidence: Separate product-approved populations from off-label use, clinical contraindications/precautions and Estar's own eligibility policy. Use current labels and professional sources; ask Alex about any practice-specific restrictions. No universal minimum age inferred from one marketing page.
investigations.resolution_owner: Research; Alex if practice-only facts remain unavailable

investigations.question_or_claim: Is a lip flip an approved indication for the product used, and which filler formulations are approved for the intended lip use?
investigations.why_it_matters: Avoid describing approval of a product as approval of every use or every brand formulation.
investigations.adequate_resolution_evidence: Locate current Botox Cosmetic labeling and relevant filler device approvals/labeling. Identify exact product, intended use, age limits and distinctions between labeled and off-label use. Match verified practice formulations when known; leave inventory unresolved separately.
investigations.resolution_owner: Research; Alex if practice-only facts remain unavailable

investigations.question_or_claim: What recovery restrictions, swelling expectations and appointment planning can responsibly be stated?
investigations.why_it_matters: Reader needs realistic daily-life and event planning, not blanket no-downtime assurances.
investigations.adequate_resolution_evidence: Compare product/clinical guidance on activity, recovery and settling. Distinguish injection time from the full consultation/appointment. Obtain Estar's current protocol through Alex where needed; do not convert generic published timings into current booking promises.
investigations.resolution_owner: Research; Alex if practice-only facts remain unavailable

investigations.question_or_claim: Can effects be reversed, and what limits apply to stopping a lip flip or dissolving lip filler?
investigations.why_it_matters: A key decision concern; no guarantee that either treatment can be immediately undone.
investigations.adequate_resolution_evidence: Use clinical evidence and relevant labeling for temporary neuromodulator effects and hyaluronic-acid filler management. Distinguish filler materials, time, risks and limitations of dissolution. State uncertainty rather than calling all fillers reversible.
investigations.resolution_owner: Research; Alex if practice-only facts remain unavailable

investigations.question_or_claim: Can the treatments be combined, and what should guide the decision and sequencing?
investigations.why_it_matters: Prevents an unsupported either/or or universal combination recommendation.
investigations.adequate_resolution_evidence: Seek clinical sources for combined treatment and selection limits; ask Alex whether Estar offers combined lip plans. A general website claim that Botox works with fillers is not a lip-specific protocol.
investigations.resolution_owner: Research; Alex if practice-only facts remain unavailable

investigations.question_or_claim: How should readers compare total cost and maintenance without unsupported price or value claims?
investigations.why_it_matters: Practice page calls one option more affordable; reader needs a fair comparison.
investigations.adequate_resolution_evidence: Obtain current Estar fee basis, applicable products and consultation terms from a current permitted page or Alex. Distinguish per-unit/per-syringe charges from per-visit and repeat-treatment costs. For a general comparison, find reliable context and state variability; no local estimate from an unrelated national price range.
investigations.resolution_owner: Research for general context; Alex for current practice fees

investigations.question_or_claim: Who currently performs each lip service, with which credentials and products?
investigations.why_it_matters: Required to attribute practice expertise and write an accurate provider-specific CTA.
investigations.adequate_resolution_evidence: Recheck allowed provider/service pages; ask Alex to confirm all current lip injectors, exact treatment associations, preferred names/credentials and product formulations. A roster entry or general injectable biography is insufficient to assign each procedure.
investigations.resolution_owner: Alex if website evidence does not establish current service associations

investigations.question_or_claim: What is the appropriate current consultation/booking route, and is there a fee or specific appointment name?
investigations.why_it_matters: Treatment availability and bookable appointment details are different records.
investigations.adequate_resolution_evidence: Use observed contact/service links as candidates. In an authorized later stage, verify the route without submitting a booking or personal information; obtain Alex's confirmation of appointment type, provider access and fees when needed. Do not promise a free consultation or open time slot.
investigations.resolution_owner: Alex for unpublished consultation terms and current booking associations

investigations.question_or_claim: What practice-specific approach or technology meaningfully helps explain this lip comparison?
investigations.why_it_matters: Customization should add useful context, not repeat promotional superiority claims.
investigations.adequate_resolution_evidence: Use supported consultation approach and provider associations. Determine whether Image Pro is actually used for lip assessment before inclusion. Claims of superior results, unique expertise or technology benefits need relevant evidence; omit unsupported or irrelevant material.
investigations.resolution_owner: Research; Alex if practice-only facts remain unavailable

investigations.question_or_claim: Which approved quote, attributable review and official social account would add useful article-specific evidence?
investigations.why_it_matters: Assignment allows these where useful; fabrication and guessed handles are prohibited.
investigations.adequate_resolution_evidence: Ask Alex for an approved named-provider quote on goals or treatment selection and source/permission details. Require exact attributable review text/source and topic relevance before use. Confirm current official Facebook/Instagram handles rather than placeholder links. If optional material is unavailable, omit it and prepare the relevant later Doc comment.
investigations.resolution_owner: Alex for quote approval and unestablished official accounts; later verify any supplied review

investigations.question_or_claim: Which search intent, geography and keyword instructions did Alex intend?
investigations.why_it_matters: Research queries cannot replace supplied keywords or add unsupported location requirements.
investigations.adequate_resolution_evidence: Ask Alex for primary/supporting keywords, topic-selection rationale, target geography, metadata expectations and practical SEO/AEO distinction. Until answered, retain the assigned title/type and labeled working interpretation; do not pass missing-keyword checks.

investigations.question_or_claim: What do leading organic Google answers cover well or poorly, and which reader questions remain unanswered?
investigations.why_it_matters: Required competitor review should improve usefulness while preserving an independent explanation.
investigations.adequate_resolution_evidence: Run the planned queries later. Record query, date, search location/language and observed organic positions, excluding ads, map packs and AI summaries. Review the first five distinct relevant organic results or explain fewer results. Record questions, mechanisms, comparisons, costs, safety, suitability, answer structure, omissions and weak explanations with source URLs. Verify medical claims independently; no copying or competitor outbound links. Do not open Estar blogs or held-aside Benchmark completed versions.

investigations.question_or_claim: Which permitted internal links and authoritative external links will support the eventual article?
investigations.why_it_matters: Connects practice context and evidence without consulting held-aside blog material.
investigations.adequate_resolution_evidence: Recheck relevant lip service, Botox/Juvéderm, team and contact destinations. Select four useful distinct internal content links for a 1,200+ word article, with CTA separate and no repeated destination; select one-to-two authoritative external links when appropriate. Supplied/competing clinical practice pages are research inputs, not delivered competitor links. Do not force an irrelevant link or use a prohibited blog just to meet a count.
investigations.resolution_owner: Research; Alex if practice-only facts remain unavailable

google_review_controls.keyword_status: Research queries only; Alex has not supplied the primary keyword.
google_review_controls.cold_controls: Exclude estarmedspa.com blog/article results and all completed Benchmark comparison versions before opening. Ignore incidental titles/snippets and log exposure. No exact-title search for existing Estar articles.
google_review_controls.authority_rule: Ranking identifies competing answers, not medical accuracy.
google_review_controls.delivered_link_rule: No direct-competitor or directory links in the eventual article.

missing_information_process.current_state: Questions are recorded, not sent. No article draft, marker placement, Google Doc comment or batch status created.
missing_information_process.later_handling: Under User Design, omit missing optional material and add the relevant Doc comment when drafting/delivering; use visible markers and comments for missing required facts with Needs Information status. If a missing answer could change the premise or central answer, resolve direction before outlining. The later Research and Resolve dependency assessment must establish the effect of each missing answer; this plan does not settle it.

stop_conditions: This trial stops after recording the plan and checking its provenance/coverage.
Do not label the medical comparison resolved, article Ready for Review/Accepted, or production pipeline validated.
No outline, article text, comparison with held-aside writer versions, Drive setup, deployment or unattended work.
exit_assessment: Plan identifies main/supporting questions, claim and practice dependencies, adequate evidence, source candidates and Alex-only questions. Sources marked planned remain unopened and investigations remain unperformed.
